en-US.title: We are the national representatives! Introducing world-class products.
en-US.description:
Our company's products can become national representatives too!

The Pride of National Representative Products: World-Class Products

World-Class Products are selected annually to showcase our companies' superior technological capabilities to the world. They are products that are currently leading the global market or have a high potential to lead it in the future.

To date, 987 products and 1,098 companies have been selected as World-Class Products. For 2025, 83 new products and 87 new companies have been selected!

What are the benefits of being selected as a World-Class Product?

By receiving the official credibility of a national representative product, you can increase buyer trust during overseas marketing. Additionally, you receive preferential bonus points when applying for export marketing programs and can receive support for export-related financing and consulting!!

The recruitment announcement for the 2026 World-Class Product new selection is scheduled to run from May 18 (Mon) to June 30 (Tue). We ask for your continued interest!

id.title: Kami adalah perwakilan nasional! Memperkenalkan produk-produk kelas dunia.
id.description:
Produk perusahaan kami juga dapat menjadi perwakilan nasional!

Kebanggaan Produk Perwakilan Nasional: Produk Kelas Dunia

Produk Kelas Dunia dipilih setiap tahun untuk memamerkan kemampuan teknologi unggul perusahaan kami kepada dunia. Produk-produk ini saat ini memimpin pasar global atau memiliki potensi tinggi untuk memimpinnya di masa depan.

Hingga saat ini, 987 produk dan 1.098 perusahaan telah terpilih sebagai Produk Kelas Dunia. Untuk tahun 2025, 83 produk baru dan 87 perusahaan baru telah terpilih!

Apa manfaat terpilih sebagai Produk Kelas Dunia?

Dengan menerima kredibilitas resmi sebagai produk perwakilan nasional, Anda dapat meningkatkan kepercayaan pembeli selama pemasaran di luar negeri. Selain itu, Anda menerima poin bonus preferensial saat mengajukan program pemasaran ekspor dan dapat menerima dukungan untuk pembiayaan dan konsultasi terkait ekspor!!

Pengumuman perekrutan untuk seleksi baru Produk Kelas Dunia 2026 dijadwalkan berlangsung dari 18 Mei (Senin) hingga 30 Juni (Selasa). Kami mohon perhatian Anda terus berlanjut!

snippet.title: [무역의 참견] EP.02 미국편! K-뷰티, 세계시장 공략기
snippet.description:

snippet.title: [세계이슈톡톡] EP04. EU CBAM 하위법령 및 강화 개정안 주요 내용
snippet.description:
CBAM 개정안 보고서 바로가기 👇👇
https://dream.kotra.or.kr/dream/kotra/actionKotraShortUrl/iqLJ5uGu2tNc.do

2026년 1월 1일부터 본격 시행주인 CBAM, 잘 준비하고 계신가요?

25년 12월 철강, 알루미늄 하류 제품까지 적용 범위를 확대하는 등 EU 집행위원회는 CBAM 강화 개정안을 발표했습니다. 

주요 내용은 다음과 같습니다.

기존 6대 CBAM 규제 품목 중 철강, 알루미늄을 함유하는 약 180개의 최종재를 추가하며, 적용 범위가 확대됩니다.

또한 품목별 CN 코드를 기존 규정 대비 세분화하고, 우회 행위를 방지하기 위해 입증 자료 요구나 동향 모니터링이 확대됩니다.

그렇다면 26년 우리 기업이 알아두어야 하는 사항은 무엇일까요?

첫번째로는 CBAM 대상 품목 통관 코드가 신설되어 수입 통관 시 유의해야한다는 점입니다. 

또한 CBAM 코드를 확인하거나 배출 데이터 산정 근거 자료 마련을 위해 본격적인 준비가 필요합니다.

생산·수출 기업과 수입 기업별 전반적인 대응 체계 구축에도 차이가 있으니, 꼭 확인하여 준비하여야 합니다.

구체적인 CN 코드 등 더욱 자세한 정보는 KOTRA 해외시장뉴스의 해당 보고서를 참고해주세요.

en-US.title: [Global Issue TalkTalk] EP04. Key Details of the EU CBAM Implementing Regulation and Strengthened...
en-US.description:
Direct Link to CBAM Amendment Report 👇👇

https://dream.kotra.or.kr/dream/kotra/actionKotraShortUrl/iqLJ5uGu2tNc.do

Are you well prepared for CBAM, which goes into full effect on January 1, 2026?

In December 2025, the European Commission announced amendments to strengthen CBAM, including expanding the scope of application to include downstream products of steel and aluminum.

The key details are as follows:

The scope of application is expanded by adding approximately 180 finished goods containing steel and aluminum to the existing six major CBAM regulated items.

In addition, CN codes by item are subdivided compared to existing regulations, and requirements for supporting documentation and trend monitoring are expanded to prevent circumvention.

So, what should our companies be aware of in 2026?

First, new customs clearance codes for CBAM-대상 items have been established, so caution is required during import customs clearance. In addition, full-scale preparation is required to verify CBAM codes or prepare supporting data for calculating emission data.

Since there are differences in establishing overall response systems between production/export companies and import companies, you must verify and prepare accordingly.

For more detailed information, including specific CN codes, please refer to the relevant reports in KOTRA Overseas Market News.

en-US.title: [World Issue Talk] EP.01 Tariffs on Steel, Aluminum, and Copper: '0 Won' if Content is Less Than ...
en-US.description:
A must-read for companies preparing to export to the U.S.! ✈️ The previously complex method for calculating tariffs on steel, aluminum, and copper has changed drastically starting April 6, 2026.

Instead of the headache-inducing calculation of metal content, the method has been unified based on the 'total product price,' reducing administrative burdens and increasing predictability. 📈

✅ Key Points

1️⃣ Administrative Simplification: Simple calculations based on customs clearance price instead of complex content verification!

2️⃣ Exemption Benefits: Excluded from tariffs if the metal weight is less than 15%!

3️⃣ Strategic Opportunities: Certain items, such as cosmetics and food, are exempt from regulations, improving the export environment!

Understanding the changed rules reveals new opportunities. We are rooting for our companies' successful entry into the U.S. market!🤝
